name: mode_quartic_steps_coronene
purpose: TASKS 207 (a) (the user, 13 Nov: do whatever the labels' quality needs): the grid is cleared (two grids give coronene's phi_iiii within 0.7 %), but the two routes are 36 % apart - the displaced-Hessian QFF has 711.1 cm-1 for mode 36 where the energy stencil at h = 0.5 has 456.6. This run takes the energy stencil at h = 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 at route A's own grid (75,302), the grid the labels were built on. The five-point stencil's leading error goes as h^2, so CONVERGED says the quartic constant is the potential's and the QFF route is the one in error, STEP_DEPENDENT says the sixth derivative is large and the quartic truncation itself is the limit (a decision point with a cost). Readings registered in probes/mode_quartic_scan.py. The 9 points of the first run were carried in under their displacement names (carried_points.json), so only the four displacements +-0.25 and +-2.0 per mode are new

estimate.basis: 8 new SCFs of coronene (36 atoms, 6-31G* spherical) at 8 threads; the first run took 1 h 54 min for 18 of them, so about 50 min, with margin for the wider displacements at +-2.0 converging more slowly

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops it at 4096 MB (CAP_MB); the first run of the same molecule and basis held under it
